# Plan v1 — Build 1a rest — Awaiting approval

**Quick read** · about 330 words · about 2 min

**Summary**
- Goal: finish Build 1a as one pull request: the ice chip, the ice-season line, the ice wording, the red Bait ban line and chip, the popup close fix, the README counts, the slider label and the winter guard. Done when: all tests pass, the pictures show only the planned changes, and the pull request is open and ready.
- Stages: 7 · lanes: 2 · stops for you: 1 · pull requests: 1.
- I need from you: Approve.

**What changed since** First version

**Decisions:** None open. Your answers on record: Apr 1–Nov 30 lakes get "Early and late ice"; the guard looks at the past 7 days; README says 35; pictures are made here only; the guard applies to today and to each day in the 7-day view.

Checked against: the design file features of the last commit (kept as they are), the map of the code, the GitHub checks (tests plus a data rebuild), the empty record files.
Removes: the README section that said 31 walleye and pike waters are hidden. Nothing else is removed.

**Stops**
- Round 1: merge #— and device read (stages 1–6) · stop: merge.

**Limits**
- GitHub run about 3 min (tests, then a data rebuild that must match the data files) · the full test file about 1 min · pictures are made in this session only · GitHub has no browser.

7 stages: 6 build steps by Claude (records, picture tool, ice logic, README, popup and chips, review and pull request), then 1 check (your merge and device read)

Technical details

**Agreed points (stage 1 writes these into WORKING_RECORD.md under `## Design decisions` as `- [agreed] {point} — search: {phrase}`)**
- [agreed] The ice chip "Open for ice fishing" also shows early-ice and late-ice lakes, not only all-winter lakes — search: early-ice and late-ice lakes
- [agreed] Every popup has an ice-season line; the three Apr 1–Nov 30 lakes get the fifth line "Early and late ice — closed Dec 1 to Mar 31" — search: Early and late ice — closed Dec 1 to Mar 31
- [agreed] Ice wording in the popup and the winter guard: "Legal is not safe. Ice thickness is never forecast." — search: Legal is not safe
- [agreed] A red Bait ban line at the top of the popup for the 25 bait-ban lakes — search: red Bait ban line
- [agreed] A Bait ban chip, built like the Aerated chip — search: Bait ban chip
- [agreed] The top-right map buttons never cover the popup close button; the popup close button stays clear — search: popup close button stays clear
- [agreed] README: walleye and pike waters are shown; 35 walleye and pike waters (33 walleye, 1 pike, 1 both) from the data, with a test that counts the data and checks the README number; the species filter has nine species — search: 35 walleye and pike waters
- [agreed] The distance slider gets a slider label for screen readers — search: slider label for screen readers
- [agreed] Winter guard: when every daily mean in the past 7 days before the chosen time is below 0 °C, hide the open-water score and show "Ice likely"; applies to today and to each day of the 7-day view — search: Ice likely
- [agreed] Picture references are made in this session only; the picture tool is not added to the GitHub check — search: picture references
- [agreed] The design file features of commit 1798292 are kept as they are: Aerated badge and filter, thin-ice warning Oct–Apr, "Season and ice" filter group, ACA winter angling column, Spring Lake note, split-season fix — search: design file features kept
- [agreed] One pull request for all of Build 1a, opened ready (not draft) after the reviewer; the owner merges — search: one pull request

**Repo facts** · branch `test-with-config` · design commit `1798292` touched `index.html`, `js/conditions.js`, `sw.js`, `README.md`, `data/aca_aeration_roster.csv`, `scripts/test_regression_checks.py` · GitHub `.github/workflows/checks.yml` runs `cd scripts && python -m unittest discover -p "test_*.py" -v`, then rebuilds `data/` with `build_history.py` and fails on any diff — this plan changes no file in `data/` · local run: `python3 scripts/test_regression_checks.py` · tests pin `sw.js` precache and the script tags; no new JS file is added, so `SHELL_FILES` stays · no picture test exists today.

**Stage 1 — records** (sonnet-worker; files `FEATURES.md`, `WORKING_RECORD.md`)
- `FEATURES.md`: by-screen seed shape (`/root/.cache/hz-rules/3.3.1/seed/FEATURES.md`). Sections: Map and pins · Filter panel (incl. "Season and ice" group: Open today, Open for ice fishing, Aerated) · Lake popup (verdict line, aeration block with thin-ice warning Oct–Apr, depth, regulation block with Season row and Bait row, photos, actions) · Lake panel · Conditions panel (next 6 h strip, 7-day grid, CLOSED today block, water input, solunar) · Offline (service worker caches) · Data and rules (season parsing incl. split season, ACA winter angling column, Spring Lake note, regulation basis kinds). Source: `README.md` and `index.html`; over-list. Each line ends `— Proof: {test name | picture tests/reference/{screen}-{size}.png}`. Mark the six design-file features "kept".
- `## References`: `Sizes: phone 390×844, ipad 820×1180, pc 1440×900 · Looks: one look` · `Tests: index.html, js/*.js, data/*, scripts/* → cd scripts && python3 -m unittest discover -p "test_*.py"` · `Tests: README.md counts → scripts/test_readme_counts.py` · `Tests: screens → python3 tests/pictures.py compare` · `Tools: tests/pictures.py — makes and compares the reference pictures`.
- `WORKING_RECORD.md`: `## Approved baseline` (Plan v1, 9 items + kept design features); `## Request ledger` rows 1–9 plus row 10 "design file features kept"; `## Design decisions` with the agreed points above, exact text; `## Deliverable ledger` one row per stage 2–6; `## Where we are`; keep template headers.

**Stage 2 — picture tool and baselines** (opus-worker; new `tests/pictures.py`, `tests/requirements.txt` (playwright, pillow), `tests/fixtures/weather-october.json`, `tests/fixtures/weather-freeze.json`, `tests/reference/*.png`; add `tests/out/` to `.gitignore`)
- `python3 tests/pictures.py before|after|compare`. Serves repo root with `http.server` on a free port; Playwright Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers`); fixed clock `2026-10-13T12:00:00`; route `**/api.open-meteo.com/**` to the fixture (shape per `js/weather.js:45`: daily `temperature_2m_mean`, `past_days=7`, `forecast_days=7`, plus hourly fields the app reads); abort tile requests; no geolocation; empty storage.
- Screens × 3 sizes: `map` · `filters` (wait for `#season-group` to unhide) · `popup` (deep link to a bait-ban lake, aerated if one exists) · `lake-panel` · `conditions` (october fixture) · `conditions-freeze` (7 past daily means below 0 °C) = 18 pictures `tests/reference/{screen}-{phone|ipad|pc}.png`.
- `compare`: Pillow pixel compare, tolerance ≤ 0.2 % differing pixels; prints the Proof line. Not added to `checks.yml`.

**Stage 3 — ice season logic** (opus-worker; `js/conditions.js`, `js/conditions-ui.js`, `index.html`, `scripts/test_regression_checks.py`)
- `js/conditions.js` after `seasonOpenAllWinter` (614–621): `iceSeason(text)` → `"all-winter" | "early" | "late" | "early-late" | "closed" | null`. null when `seasonOpenAllWinter` is null; `"all-winter"` when true; else `early = seasonOpenOn(text, Nov 30) === true`, `late = seasonOpenOn(text, Apr 1) === true`; both → `"early-late"`, one → `"early"`/`"late"`, none → `"closed"`. `iceLikely(dailyMeans)` → true only with ≥ 7 values and the last 7 all `< 0`. Export both; keep the pinned strings `seasonOpenAllWinter: seasonOpenAllWinter` and `while ((m = re.exec(t)) !== null)`.
- Expected classes: all-winter 298 · early 1 (MAY 8–NOV 30) · late 2 (APR 1–OCT 31) · early-late 3 (APR 1–NOV 30) · closed 6. If the read differs, report and use the read.
- `index.html`: `lakeIceSeason(lake)` beside `lakeOpenAllWinter` (2038–2042). Chip predicate (1571): `if (state.iceFishing && lakeIceSeason(lake) === "closed") return false;`. `#ice-chip` (982) `title="All winter, early ice or late ice"`. In `regulationBlock` after the Season row (2121–2122): a new reg-row with key "Ice" (classes reg-row, reg-k, reg-v, as the Season row) — all-winter "Open all winter" · early "Early ice only — open to Nov 30" · late "Late ice only — open from Apr 1" · early-late "Early and late ice — closed Dec 1 to Mar 31" · closed "Closed — no ice fishing" · null: no row. For every class except closed, Oct–Apr, add the text "Legal is not safe. Ice thickness is never forecast." in a span with class ice-warn. Do not change `aerationBlock` (test 2001–2008).
- `js/conditions-ui.js` `render()` (568): `means = Weather.dailyMeansUpTo(wx.data, new Date())`; when `Conditions.iceLikely(means)` and not closed: no `verdictHtml`, body uses the cx-closed block pattern: bold "Ice likely", then "Every daily mean in the past 7 days is below 0 °C.", then in cx-why "Open-water score hidden. Legal is not safe. Ice thickness is never forecast."; keep weather line, horizon chips, source row. `gridHtml` (266, cells 296–304): a day whose own past 7 daily means are all below 0 shows "Ice likely" instead of scores. `waterFromAir.likelyIce` stays.
- Python mirror `ice_season`, `ice_likely` next to 2041–2050; tests in `WinterSeasonTests`: one per class, data class counts, `ice_likely` true/false/short cases; source pins `"iceSeason: iceSeason"`, `"iceLikely: iceLikely"`, the reg-k "Ice" key, `"Legal is not safe. Ice thickness is never forecast."`, `"Ice likely"` in `js/conditions-ui.js`.
- Pictures `after` + `compare`; planned changes: `popup`, `conditions-freeze`.

**Stage 4 — README and counts** (sonnet-worker; `README.md`, new `scripts/test_readme_counts.py`, `sw.js`)
- `README.md` 530–540: section "Walleye and pike waters": shown; 35 waters stocked only with walleye or pike (33 walleye, 1 pike, 1 both); remove the `out_of_scope.csv` sentence; fix line ~31 (file retired, header only). 593: "six" → "nine" (SPECIES_ORDER `index.html:1168`).
- `scripts/test_readme_counts.py`: union stocked species per `lake_id` over `data/lakes_20*.json`; count sets ⊆ {WALL, NRPK} (35; 33/1/1); assert README number; count SPECIES_ORDER and assert README word "nine".
- `sw.js:28` `SHELL_CACHE = "troutmap-shell-v4"` with comment on the new Conditions functions.

**Stage 5 — bait ban, popup close, slider, pictures** (sonnet-worker; `index.html`, `scripts/test_regression_checks.py`, `tests/reference/*.png`, `FEATURES.md`)
- `lakeBaitBan(lake)`: `/bait ban/i.test(regulationFor(lake).bait || "")`. Popup (2257–2260) after `.ats`: a div with class bait-ban and text "Bait ban", CSS red as `.reg-open.no`, weight 600. Bait rows stay.
- Chip: button class chip, id baitban-chip, type button, aria-pressed false, text "Bait ban", after `#aerated-chip` (983); state `baitBanOnly` (1314); predicate (1572); toggle loop 2817–2833; URL `bait=1` (3581/3606); reset ~3205; `updateFilterSummary` 3009.
- Both `bindPopup` (2482, ~2554): `autoPanPaddingTopRight: L.point(mapBtnsWidth() + 18, 10)`; `mapBtnsWidth()` = `.map-btns` `offsetWidth` or 150. Check mobile rule 901.
- Slider 989–991: label `id="dist-label"`, `aria-labelledby="dist-label"` on `#dist-slider`, `aria-valuetext` set in `updateDistanceLabel` (2993–3006).
- Tests: `id="baitban-chip"`, `class="bait-ban"`, `baitBanOnly`, `bait=1`, both `bindPopup` have `autoPanPaddingTopRight`, slider `aria-labelledby`, 25 bait-ban lakes.
- Pictures `after` + `compare`; planned: `popup`, `filters`, `conditions-freeze`; move changed after-pictures into `tests/reference/`; regression table and new features into `FEATURES.md`.

**Stage 6 — review and pull request** (main session): reviewer with diff, ledger rows and `FEATURES.md`; findings to sonnet-worker; full tests + `tests/pictures.py compare`; push `test-with-config`; one pull request, ready, with Proof line and regression table; commit this plan file; update `WORKING_RECORD.md`.

Agreed points: 12 of 12 in the plan
